-----------------------below is pushing to docker hub but aws eks fail becoz of credential---------------------------------------------------
name: Tax Price Calculator CI/CD to AWS EKS

on:
  workflow_dispatch

jobs:

  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [tax-service, price-service]

    steps:
      # 1. Checkout CI repo (this repo)
      - name: Checkout CI Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2. Checkout SOURCE CODE repo
      - name: Checkout Source Code Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ChNira2024/microservices-tax-price-calculation
          path: app-code

      # 3. Setup Java
      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      # 4. Build
      - name: Build Service
        working-directory: app-code/${{ matrix.service }}
        run: mvn -B clean verify


  docker-build-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-test
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [tax-service, price-service]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout CI Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout Source Code Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ChNira2024/microservices-tax-price-calculation
          path: app-code

      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Build JAR
        working-directory: app-code/${{ matrix.service }}
        run: mvn -B clean package -DskipTests

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build & Push Docker Image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: app-code/${{ matrix.service }}
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/${{ matrix.service }}:latest


  deploy-aws-eks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: docker-build-push

    steps:
      - name: Checkout CI Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v5
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ap-south-1

      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name hello-cluster --region ap-south-1

      - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f k8s/aws/microservices-tax-price-calculation/tax-service
          kubectl apply -f k8s/aws/microservices-tax-price-calculation/price-service

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		  
NOTE: Here i click action->workflow manually to start the pipeline becoz both are not connected means if i chnage source code then it will not start/trigger the pipeline becoz both are different repository 
so not connected...For automatic trigger when code changes happens, pipeline start automatice for this scenario follow below code...

Repo 1 → microservices-tax-price-calculation (CI)
Repo 2 → docker-k8s-deployment (CD)

1. CI PIPELINE 
 In: microservices-tax-price-calculation repo, create action workflow..
.github/workflows/ci.yml
--------------------------
name: CI - Build, Push & Trigger CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [tax-service, price-service]

    steps:
      # 1. Checkout code
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2. Setup Java
      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      # 3. Build JAR
      - name: Build Service
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.service }}
        run: mvn clean package -DskipTests

      # 4. Docker Login
      - name: Docker Login
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      # 5. Build & Push Docker Image
      - name: Build & Push Image
        run: |
          docker build -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/${{ matrix.service }}:${{ github.sha }} ./${{ matrix.service }}
          docker push ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/${{ matrix.service }}:${{ github.sha }}

      # 6. Trigger CD Pipeline (IMPORTANT)
      - name: Trigger CD Repo
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
          -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}" \
          -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
          https://api.github.com/repos/ChNira2024/docker-k8s-deployment/actions/workflows/cd.yml/dispatches \
          -d '{"ref":"main"}'

=>Add in code repo:
DOCKER_USERNAME
DOCKER_PASSWORD
PAT_TOKEN
👉 PAT_TOKEN = GitHub Personal Access Token (repo access)		  

2. CD PIPELINE (INFRA REPO)
In: docker-k8s-deployment repo, create action workflow..
.github/workflows/cd.yml
--------------------------------
name: CD - Deploy to AWS EKS

on:
  workflow_dispatch

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # 1. Checkout infra repo
      - name: Checkout Infra Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2. Configure AWS
      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v5
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ap-south-1

      # 3. Setup kubectl
      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4

      # 4. Connect to EKS
      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name hello-cluster --region ap-south-1

      # 5. Deploy
      - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f k8s/aws/microservices-tax-price-calculation/tax-service
          kubectl apply -f k8s/aws/microservices-tax-price-calculation/price-service

=>REQUIRED SECRETS (INFRA REPO)
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

Code Push (Repo 1)
      ↓
CI runs automatically ✅
      ↓
Build + Docker Push
      ↓
Trigger CD Repo via API ✅
      ↓
CD pipeline starts
      ↓
Deploy to AWS EKS 🚀

Why workflow_dispatch in CD?

👉 Because CI triggers it manually using API
👉 So no need for push here

✅ Why PAT_TOKEN?
👉 Needed to call another repo’s workflow
👉 Without it → ❌ trigger fails
